Questions people ask before they book

Do I need any equipment at all? ＋

No. PA is handled entirely by me — dual SOUNDBOKS stereo system, microphones, karaoke screen/library, and setup. You provide the space and a power outlet.

Are the song licenses really covered? ＋

Yes. The karaoke library runs through KaraFun and the licenses are covered by me, so you're not relying on random YouTube karaoke videos.

How far will you travel? ＋

Special events up to 20 miles from Fresno's Tower District. If you're just outside that, ask — we'll talk about it when we set the scope.

What does the hourly rate depend on? ＋

Event size, number of hours, and scope of services — for example, adding pro line recordings for guests. It's negotiated and agreed before the event, on top of the $100 base rate.

Can guests really take a recording home? ＋

Yes, when recording is included in your booking. It's a pro line recording taken directly from the PA system, offered as a souvenir of the performance.

Do you have references? ＋

Yes — references are available on request. Just ask when you send your date.
